lines.en: I have been working in marketing for five years, and I feel ready for more responsibility.
My main goal is to become a team leader by next year, if the company agrees.
I would like to improve my communication skills, because I often present ideas to clients.
If I get the promotion, I will have more responsibility, but less free time.
She is looking for a job with more flexibility, since she has two young children.
Working under pressure has taught me how to stay organized and manage my time.
I am planning to take an online course so that I can learn the skills my job requires.
The salary matters, but I would never accept a job with an unfriendly work environment.
He decided to quit his job and start a company after he realized he was not learning anything.
Setting clear goals helps you measure your progress and stay motivated when work gets difficult.
